options.name: upstream
options.help: the inverter Modbus TCP endpoint HOST:PORT (`:5502` = 127.0.0.1:5502)

options.name: modbus-auth-key
options.setting-help: the suite handshake's shared key, min 16 characters (`file:<path>` reads an owner-only file)
options.help: the shared key the suite handshake proves (min 16 characters); the value may be `file:<path>` — the first line of an owner-only 0600 file (a systemd LoadCredential rides as file:/run/credentials/...)

options.name: modbus-merge-gap
options.setting-help: max register gap when merging the profile's source ranges into block reads; the plan rebuilds
options.help: max register gap when merging ranges into block reads, 0 = read ranges separately

options.name: metrics
options.setting-help: the Prometheus /metrics exposition: the listen address, the serving limits, the bearer auth, the connect ACL, the spec and the prefix

options.name: metrics-spec
options.setting-help: metrics spec JSON, sectioned: {inputs: {name: {help}}, metrics: {key: {profile?, expr?, when?, help, type?}}, scraper:...} — the metrics entries are register- (profile) or expression-fed (expr/when) over the declared inputs (show inputs), merged in memory over the built-in lib/metrics.json scraper_* block
options.help: metrics spec JSON, sectioned: {inputs: {name: {help}}, metrics: {key: {profile?, expr?, when?, help, type?}}, scraper:...} — the metrics entries are register- (profile) or expression-fed (expr/when) over the declared inputs (show inputs), merged in memory over the built-in lib/metrics.json scraper_* block

options.name: metrics-prefix
options.setting-help: the prefix on the profile- and compute-fed metric names
options.help: the prefix on the profile- and compute-fed metric names; the bundled scraper_* names are fixed

options.name: modbus/caps
options.setting-help: the sanity caps the polled readings must pass: the PV array and the grid ceilings

options.name: system
options.setting-help: the daemon's own serving socket: the listen address

options.name: metrics/limits
options.setting-help: the /metrics serving limits (the client caps and the idle timeouts)

value-help.0: never (the built-in slowloris cap still applies on the metrics surfaces that have one)

options.name: control-port
options.help: JSON-lines control server target: unix socket path or TCP port number on 127.0.0.1 (e.g. 15599); 0 = off. Talk to it with modbus-scraper-ctl.py

options.name: control-ops-token
options.setting-help: a second, read-only control token: sessions authenticating with it may run its policy's verbs only (the default policy: show) (no set/clear, no request poll now, no request reload, no restart, no shutdown) — the ops shift against the admin key, both audited (`file:<path>` = the token from an owner-only file)
options.help: a second, read-only control token: sessions authenticating with it may run its policy's verbs only (the default policy: show) (no set/clear, no request poll now, no request reload, no restart, no shutdown) — the ops shift against the admin key, both audited; the value may be `file:<path>` — the first line of an owner-only 0600 file (a systemd LoadCredential rides as file:/run/credentials/...)

options.name: control-log-replies
options.no-env: the debug toggle rides the flags

options.name: metrics/auth
options.setting-help: the /metrics bearer auth: the token the exposition endpoint requires

options.name: auth-token
options.setting-help: require Authorization: Bearer <token> on all requests — startup-only (pass it by flag/env/config); the value never renders back (`file:<path>` = the token from an owner-only file)
options.help: require Authorization: Bearer <token> on all requests; the value may be `file:<path>` — the first line of an owner-only 0600 file (a systemd LoadCredential rides as file:/run/credentials/...)

options.name: log-access
options.setting-help: log every HTTP request at INFO

value-help.on: audit trail for who polled /metrics and when

options.help: log every HTTP request at INFO

value-help.DEBUG: per-poll detail + the HTTP access log at DEBUG

show.name: connections
show.setting-help: the live HTTP clients of /metrics: the gate counters, one row per peer IP

show.name: inputs
show.setting-help: the declared compute expression inputs (the reserved four and the spec's declared entries), each bracketed with the metric whose value it carries

show.name: inputs-metrics
show.setting-help: the exported metrics: one [section]-bracketed line per metric the exposition serves (the built-in scraper_* block included), sorted by name

show.name: metrics-acl-table
show.setting-help: the metrics ACL as its rule chain, one entry per line: allow 0.0.0.0/0 (any), deny 0.0.0.0/0 (none), the whitelist spelled out — or the ip-prefix acl file's own rules with their descs

commands.name: inspect
commands.help: one pretty dump of everything (the state, the counters, the caps)

commands.name: request
commands.help: the state machinery: the dump written and restored, the config re-read, the poll woken, the session dropped

commands.name: request-reload
commands.help: save the live overrides and restart the whole daemon (the config file and the flags are re-resolved)

commands.name: request-restart
commands.help: drop the Modbus session (reconnects on the next poll)

commands.name: set
commands.help: configure a setting (set metrics interval 5, set log-access on)

commands.name: clear
commands.help: restore a setting to its configured value (clear modbus interval, clear system log-level)
